rows.title: No identity digits in the vault's metadata
rows.defect: only the free text is checked, so a title or tag carrying an SSN or card number is stored and shown (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: an SSN in a title, an account number as the issuer, a card in a tag are refused

rows.title: A spaced SSN is an SSN
rows.defect: only the dashed SSN shape is recognized (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "123 45 6789" as text is refused

rows.title: The total, not the subtotal
rows.defect: "total" matches inside "Subtotal" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: $43.20 after a $40.00 subtotal

rows.title: An order number is a code
rows.defect: any word after "order" is taken as the order number (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "Order Confirmation" is not order "Confirmation"; XKJQPL is kept

rows.title: No-reply mail is from the company
rows.defect: the shared-mailbox check reads the domain instead of the mailbox, so the merchant is "no reply" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: no-reply@doordash.com is doordash

rows.title: Same site is not a mismatch
rows.defect: any link whose text names a site is called a mismatch (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: www.mockbank.com linking to www.mockbank.com is clean

rows.title: Domains from the address
rows.defect: the domain is everything after the @, so a display name's closing ">" makes a mismatch (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "Mock Bank <alerts@mockbank.com>" replying from mockbank.com is clean

rows.title: "Bank of America" is bankofamerica.com
rows.defect: the claimed name is compared with its spaces (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a spaced company name matches its domain

rows.title: Signals read after "it"
rows.defect: the old signal wording comes back: "it the link text names one site" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "it links to one site while its text names another"

rows.title: January's open window
rows.defect: only this year's window is considered, so early January says "opens in 295 days" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: on Jan 10 the marketplace is open, 5 days left

rows.title: One day is "1 day"
rows.defect: every count says "days" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "(1 day)", "opens in 1 day"

rows.title: The day itself is "today"
rows.defect: a renewal today says "(0 days)"
rows.test: a renewal today says "(today)"

rows.title: Paper returns say 42 days
rows.defect: every received return is told the e-file window (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "most paper-filed refunds arrive within 42 days"

rows.title: Received but late is overdue
rows.defect: the received stage wins over the window, so the text says "by about" a date already gone (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: received 50 days ago is overdue

rows.title: Posted gifts only
rows.defect: a pending hold is counted as a second gift (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: The log cites its rows
rows.defect: the log is returned without its source and as-of (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: source and as-of on the donation log

rows.title: A revoked device is not known
rows.defect: revoked sessions count as known devices (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: Chrome in Lisbon after a revoke is new

rows.title: A lapsed policy is not a cost
rows.defect: a lapsed policy's premium is still added (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: Day 45 is in the window
rows.defect: the window ends a day early
rows.test: a renewal in 45 days is raised

rows.title: Events since the review
rows.defect: the event comparison is inverted
rows.test: a marriage after the review is due; a move before it is not

rows.title: Estimated dates for estimated payers
rows.defect: the payer condition is inverted
rows.test: no q dates without the flag

rows.title: The quarter rounds up to the dollar
rows.defect: the quarter is rounded to nearest, a dollar short
rows.test: $12,345.67 a year is $3,087.00 a quarter

rows.title: $250.00 needs an acknowledgment
rows.defect: the threshold is exclusive
rows.test: a $250.00 gift is flagged

rows.title: Ambiguity is asked, not guessed
rows.defect: the first of several candidates is taken
rows.test: two $43.20 charges match nothing

rows.title: No sessions says so
rows.defect: the empty case is not handled, so it says "0 active sessions: ." (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "No active sessions."

rows.title: The session in use stays
rows.defect: the current-session guard is dropped
rows.test: revoking this session is refused

rows.title: A converted trial explains a charge
rows.defect: a trial is left out of what makes a charge likely yours
rows.test: Mockflix with a trial is likely yours

rows.title: Photos match within 7 days
rows.defect: the photo uses the email window of 4 days
rows.test: a photo dated 6 days before the charge matches
